value.description: One line; never echoed or logged.

models.description: model_api_key: models the gateway lists (0 when it serves no list).

SecretCheck.description: The candidate value is never kept.

SecretName.description: A secret admin Setup may save (a fixed file name in the secrets directory).

SecretSource.description: absent; host: a file in the host secrets directory (it wins; Setup cannot replace it); saved: saved from Setup.

missing_intents.description: discord_intents: the privileged intents still off in the Developer Portal (Application Flags bits 14/15 and 18/19); empty when both are on. Absent when the application could not be read.

missing_env.description: chat: kanade.toml keys the chatbot still needs, e.g. discord.chat_pilot_role_id (as config.json chatbot.missing_env).

invite_url.description: bot_access: https://discord.com/oauth2/authorize?client_id=<application id>&scope=bot+applications.commands&permissions=93248 (the access report's six permissions); absent when the application could not be read.

channels_lacking.description: bot_access: watched and digest channels missing any of the six permissions; absent while the guild is not loaded.

count.description: watched_channels: watched channels plus watched categories.

open.description: public_portal: the live self_service.public_portal switch (only with a public listener).

latest_backup_at.description: backups: RFC 3339 UTC of the newest listed backup; absent when none.

recipients.description: backups: the backups directory holds a `recipients` file (snapshots are age-encrypted).

SetupItemId.description: Every item, in this order: required items first (discord_gateway … extraction_model), then optional ones.

SetupReason.description: Why an item is not ok, or a note on an ok item. gateway_off: KANADE_DISCORD_GATEWAY=0 or offline; connecting: connecting or reconnecting; gateway_closed: Discord ended the session for good (bad token or disallowed intent, until a restart); not_connected: the guild is not loaded, so permissions are unknown; unavailable: a fact could not be read within 5 s (Discord's application, module health); unreachable: the model gateway or scouter did not answer; no_listing: model_gateway is ok but serves no model list, so the operator's declared models are used; not_running: a model is saved for the role but not running; env_missing: chat is on but missing_env lists what it needs; member_sign_in_missing: a public listener without the member Discord sign-in; nexon_no_key, nexon_key_refused, nexon_backoff: character data's NEXON state; verification_required: the scouter's.

checkable.description: POST …/check can test a candidate value against its service.

restart_pending.description: A secret was saved since this process started; secrets are read at start.

restart_available.description: POST /api/admin/setup/restart is offered (a supervisor starts the process again).

SetupSource.description: Where the value comes from: `environment` (env or kanade.toml; a change needs a restart), `file`, `saved` (admin Config), `derived` (worked out live).

SetupState.description: `ok`; `missing` (not set up, or a required fact is unknown); `warn` (set up, but see `reason`); `off` (an optional feature this deployment leaves off).
